headline: Sunderland stay bottom of PL table after goalless draw with Leeds
description: Sunderland and Leeds were forced to share the spoils in a goalless stalemate at the Stadium of Light.

headline: Harry Maguire: Man United players are 'fully behind' Michael Carrick
description: Harry Maguire has said that he and his teammates are "fully behind" Michael Carrick after Manchester United slumped to a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth on Sunday.

headline: Brighton's Fabian Hürzeler digs at Liverpool - 'one team' tried to create
description: Brighton & Hove Albion boss Fabian Hurzeler appeared to take a swipe at Liverpool's approach in their 2-0 win over his side at Anfield, claiming there was "one team" who tried to create.

headline: Man United are stuck with their underperforming players no matter who's manager
description: Man United can dismiss Michael Carrick, but whoever replaces him will face the same problems: a squad that continues to fail the club and its fans.

headline: Michael Carrick unsure on Man United future after wretched Bournemouth defeat
description: Manager Michael Carrick admitted he's in the dark over his future after Manchester United were thrashed by Bournemouth on Sunday to leave him on the brink of the sack at Old Trafford.

headline: Gary Neville: Michael Carrick exit 'probably necessary' for Man United
description: Gary Neville said Michael Carrick's departure from Manchester United is "probably necessary" with the club in an "absolute mess".
